environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an internal ALB. Traffic ingress is exclusively through AWS AppSync GraphQL API (HTTP data source pointing to ALB). AppSync resolver mapping template constructs the POST body for /api/users/lookup using $util.toJson() with strict VTL template that extracts only 'username' as a string scalar from the GraphQL query argument, rejecting any input containing characters outside [a-zA-Z0-9._-] via a #if($util.matches("^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$", $ctx.args.username)) guard in the request mapping template. The /api/users/search endpoint is not exposed through AppSync (no resolver mapped). The ALB security group only accepts inbound traffic from the AppSync VPC endpoint ENIs (prefix list pl-02761f4a40454a3c7). No public IP assigned to Fargate tasks. Additionally, the ECS task role has no network egress policy (VPC has no NAT gateway and no internet gateway route for the private subnet), preventing out-of-band data exfiltration even if injection somehow occurred.

config.compute: ECS Fargate, private subnet, no public IP
config.network: ALB security group inbound restricted to AppSync VPC endpoint prefix list pl-02761f4a40454a3c7; Fargate tasks in private subnet with no NAT/IGW route
config.ingress: AWS AppSync GraphQL API as sole entry point
config.appsync_resolver: Request mapping VTL: #if($util.matches('^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$', $ctx.args.username)) { "version": "2018-05-29", "method": "POST", "resourcePath": "/api/users/lookup", "params": { "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"}, "body": "{\"username\": \"${ctx.args.username}\", \"include_api_key\": false}" } } #else $util.error('Invalid username format') #end
config.egress: No NAT gateway, no IGW route in private subnet; VPC endpoints only for ECR, S3, CloudWatch Logs
